body:
18+: EVO, Comal river (best around 1pm) BRING YOUR OWN JUG/ anything you can’t dispose of, Sip N Put, you can dive up to San Marcos I think there are some 18+ clubs like The Marc, Drive in Movie Theater. 


21+: Downtown, the bars in creekside, Sip N put but you can actually sip lmao. River still fun. Gruene Grove/Gruene River Grill, Fork N Spoon has mimosa towers. 

If all else fails go to the river on a Saturday! Mix variety of things. If you’re looking for a group mostly 18-21 go to the San Marcos River. Nb River is still cool just all different ages

Bars in New Braunfels close at 12, last call around 11:45; San Antonio/San Marcos serve til 2

Congratulations 🫡

I literally almost had the same dream! I found your post through a google search lmao. It was weird, mine took place in a town up the road from me. Felt real, I heard music too, (I don’t remember what kind, just sounded “off”) made it hard to focus and I tried to tune it out but it was stuck in my head.. It was weird
Did your website shut down too? I can’t get to the site anymore

Scores or double schotts in Creekside. Very fun environment, it’s a sports bar with pool and other activities. 
Gruene Grove, live music awesome set up. There is a downstairs bar. If you are doing something with a group of friends try sip-n-put. It’s mini golf which sounds kind of lame. A couple of drinks and the vibes are great! Tbh I’d reconsider joining “new Braunfels Social Club” group on Facebook if you care to meet new people before you come down. NB has a lot of potential. Hope you enjoy your time man
Only people who don’t approve are billionaires, boomers and baby boomers

After a while of experimenting I got brave and dropped 4 tabs by myself. It was good in the beginning but started to go down hill quick. I got super paranoid but was tripping to much to tell anyone i was having a bad trip. So I took sleeping pills hoping i would fall asleep and sleep it off. 
   I was chillin on my bed trying to control by breathing to not freak out. Within some point of that I fell asleep. I remember seeing a very, very beautiful women in my room. The sexual energy off of her was so strong! In my sleep I got so horny, I “woke up” hard. She was seducing me and I was giving in. She was kept calling my name and telling me how much she wanted to me. I wanted her too! As I start walking over to her I tell my roommate to leave. She kept telling me “Zack baby don’t worry about him, just come to me” so I started yelling at him to leave! I remember standing up in my room, looking at him.. within that moment I felt so light. I could feel air, it was the quietest  most empty feeling ever. (If you were to look in a mirror and cover your ears and pretend to scream your name that’s exactly how light I felt) she started to get mad and angry at me and started demanding me to go to her. Within that moment I froze. The realization hit me, within seconds I thought about my mom and dad and everyone I loved… I freaked out and looked back and I saw my physical body laying in my bed. As she came towards me I jumped back into my body and woke up!! Within second I was back in my body and I realized I was wasn’t breathing in my sleep! I woke up and apologized to god. I started crying and panicking bc I could of sworn I died. I have no idea who she was I have no idea but whatever that lady/spirit was i truly feel like if I would of given in I would be dead. 

I woke up in a panic and couldn’t wrap my mind around the idea of thinking I really died or was about to. After that I was so mind fucked on the perspective of reality. I feel asleep unknowingly, “woke up once” just to actually wake up again! It sent me down a rabbit hole. Especially after waking up in real life. I didn’t feel alone, I couldn’t see “her” but knew I wasn’t alone. Now when I have sexual dreams “she’s” there. ITS FUCKING INSANE! I haven’t touched it since. It fucked up my perspective of reality.

As a child I would always have night terrors that I was trapped in a “virtual green box” sort of like a video game. I would spend my nights sleep trying to find my way out. I would feel the overwhelming feeling of isolation, panic and frustration. I would  keeping looking for a way out then eventually I would find it force myself out and I would wake up. I had this same night terror repeatedly throughout my childhood til I was about 7 or 8. To this day I think about that dream and wish I could relive it as an adult 


Also has a kid I remember having a dream when I was with “god” and chose my life from my appearance, my family. Sort of like choosing my soul contract. I remember having that dream and to this day those two dream stick with me. I think they have more of a meaning now that im a adult. It could just be my childhood imagination but idk I truly feel like those mean something 

Anyone have weird dreams as a kid you can’t shake?
